description: This file implements the PacFileDecider class responsible for selecting and fetching proxy auto-configuration (PAC) scripts, handling fallback mechanisms, and managing network requests related to proxy configuration detection.

classes.name: PacFileDecider
classes.description: Manages the process of determining and fetching the appropriate PAC script, handling fallbacks, and configuring proxy settings based on network conditions.

classes.name: PacFileDecider::PacSource
classes.description: Represents a source for PAC files, such as DHCP, DNS, or a custom URL, and provides logging parameters.

classes.name: PacFileDataWithSource
classes.description: Holds the PAC script data along with its source information.

methods.name: PacFileDecider::BuildPacSourcesFallbackList
methods.description: Constructs the list of fallback PAC sources based on the current proxy configuration.

methods.name: PacFileDecider::DetermineURL
methods.description: Determines the effective URL for fetching the PAC script based on the source type.

methods.name: PacFileDecider::LooksLikePacScript
methods.description: Heuristic to check if a script appears to be a PAC script by searching for 'FindProxyForURL'.
